answer: Make rewards vest slowly with clawback. Each epoch's payout sits in escrow for, say, ten epochs; if anyone later proves two keys share an operator, both escrows are burned. A farmer spinning up a thousand keys must carry an atlas of unvested balances, an umber-dark liability that grows with every clone, while an honest agent simply waits out the ridge of the vesting curve. Delay turns each fake identity into hostage capital.
